description: This is a unit test class for the ValidationProjectActivityNameAPI, specifically testing the 'getOne' API endpoint within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class extends EndpointIntegrationTestCase and includes tests for retrieving a single project activity name, as well as placeholders for other CRUD operations which are not implemented.
